base_declaration.hypothesis: Replace only the critic penalty by frozen historical bcap while retaining the K3P optimizer, noise, A2, host and sampling contracts.
base_declaration.mechanism_rationale: Fixed real/fake squared L2 gradients replace the K3P LR-dependent penalty and anchor. Coefficient1, cap1; no tuning.

progression.policy: every declared configuration advances independently through ordinary prerequisites to the tier cap

qualification_scope: declared tuning tasks only; provisional Forge gates

selection.objective: required PASS count by ascending tuning tier (descending); configuration hash (ascending)

spec.hypothesis: Lower global/prior rates and stronger fixed BCap penalties reduce Gaussian location drift and ring tails while one global recipe retains every Tier 1 behavior.
spec.rationale: Saved Gaussian outputs have acceptable late standardized shape but drifting location; matched ring contrasts favor prior1/coefficient1 over prior4/coefficient.5. Use lower global rates rather than repeat the measured LR.00425/prior1/coefficient1 arm. The numerical grid keeps D2/cap1 and all mechanisms fixed. Complete independent Tier 1 jobs; no seed experiments, scientific retries, higher tiers or public-default adoption.

speed_selection.reason: No frozen comparable first-acquisition timing contract is implemented for this search. Not all required adapters record per-observation seconds; original terminal-suffix or coverage-only times cannot supply full-quality first-acquisition speed.
